title: Chapter 588
paragraphs: Chapter 588
Episode 152. Quaul Ganesto (3)

Quaul, known for his somewhat tricky personality, surprisingly got along well with his colleagues upon arrival. He was a bit gruff, but his rough yet affectionate demeanor towards the children quickly won over the team.
"Master, everyone seems to miss Murakan."
Gilly sat next to Jin and said. She and Jin were watching the children teasing Quaul, calling him a bandit or a bandit leader.
"Murakan?"
"When Murakan was here, it always felt lively. He would yell and scream, but in reality, he looked after everyone, and played well with the children. I guess Quaul is taking over that role now."
"He seems to play well with the children, but he hasn't started taking care of the other colleagues yet, right? Quaul has only been here for three hours."
At that, Gilly's eyes widened. Come to think of it, Jin was right.

In the last three hours, all Quaul had done with his colleagues was appoint Amela as his assistant and, after offering the same to Beris and being flatly rejected, exchanged a few choice words with him.
He even got punched in the jaw by Quikantel, but he didn't get discouraged or depressed.
"Oh, um, yeah?"
Jin figured Gilly just missed Murakan.
'It feels weird thinking they could become a couple...'
Both of them were like parents to Jin.
That's why Jin felt a strange sensation every time there was an odd atmosphere between the two.
"Hmm, uh-huh. I'll go take care of some overdue work, master."
After Gilly disappeared, Jin chuckled.
'I wonder if Murakan is doing well.'
Murakan was currently away, standing in for Misha. He was performing his duties as the deputy's deputy.
Jin didn't know exactly what he was doing. As it was a god's job, he could only assume it involved maintaining the balance and order of the world.
Even Misha didn't know everything about the work she was doing. It was because it was beyond the cognitive ability of mortals.
"Amela, sir."
Rolling, this time Amela, dressed in a round bushy outfit, rolled over to Jin.
"Speak, my lord."
"You were talking to Quaul for a long time earlier, what do you think?"
"About his ability?"
"Yes."
"Even if I had ten of me, I couldn't catch up with Quaul."
"Is it that much?"

"He's technically centuries ahead. We agreed to work together on the all-weather acceleration annihilator, a mana suction injection type, from today, but he's already solved a few problems that I couldn't. It will take some time to perfect it, but it won't be long before it surpasses Cojek's main cannon."
Quaul's claim that meeting him was the greatest fortune was not an exaggeration.
Amela, a mercenary before a researcher, seemed to even admire Quaul.
"It's insane that Zipfel just left that guy alone. That's their biggest mistake."
There was another reason why Quaul was left in the wilderness.
Zipfel, under the illusion that they had used most of his capabilities.
'It wasn't wrong. Until recently.'
It's true that Quaul was a genius from the start.
However, his abilities as an engineer were on the rise in real-time.
Like he just realized he was of 'Ganesto' lineage, some of his 'inherited memories' that were sealed as the power of the story weakened after the War of the Swords were being released.
'Knight Lokia Ganesto of the Tenth, set up a device so that memories would continue to be passed on to descendants... Is this it?'
Memory inheritance.

Jin had already physically experienced that this was possible with the help of the Nameless Brothers. Hister is also leaving magic, mana, records, and memories to his descendants through the 'inheritance point'.
Ganesto was also achieving a similar memory transfer in some way. Zipfel was completely unaware of this.
Even so, Zipfel should have rather killed Quaul or taken special care of him. They would have done so if they hadn't been badly hit at the War of the Swords.
"Soon, they will be looking for Quaul again. So, Sir Amela, please keep a close eye on Quaul. We must strictly discourage him from going out of Tikan."
"Do you mean to keep him locked up and just do research?"
"That's what it means."
"Don't worry about that. Even if I tell him to go out, he'll be stuck in the lab. But I will make an effort to pay more attention."
There was a lot to do through Quaul.
And all those tasks had to bring better results than when Rosa chose the 'prophet'.

-I originally planned to use them through the prophet. However, my mind changed when I suspended Joshua's rider qualification this time. I will postpone negotiations with the prophet. During that period, prove to me that there is a better way than the prophet.
-If I fail, the Acting Master will... hand them over to the prophet. I see what you're saying.
"Rosa was still adamant about handing over the machine and ship designs to the prophet at any time.
'If the Black Emperor War hadn't inflicted so much damage on Zipfel, my mother would have tried to take those designs from me immediately.'
She never told Jin, but Rosa actually wanted to negotiate with the prophet right away and complete the machine and ship. Like Qwaul, she too experienced internal changes after the war.
The only reason Rosa was delaying the negotiations was that the family's power had weakened. If a variable occurred in the negotiations with the prophet, they had fewer means to cope with it.

The extent of the prophet's power is not yet fully known. The only assumption can be that they are not capable enough to overthrow the family, as they have not directly influenced the Sword Garden yet.
"But for now, disguise Mr. Qwaul with Golden Thread products. And Ms. Amella, please prepare to go out."
"Oh, where are we going?"
"There are guys who need to pay for their actions. If they try to cheat again, I don't have the means to catch them, so I need your help."
Kinzelo Meeting.
As always, Kinzelo's executives were looking at Ainas and Bubare running around with disturbed eyes.
"Ron Highran... I never thought he would come to Genesis."
Even Margiella, who always had a bright expression, had a deep thought on her face.
She had foreseen Dante's death even before the Black Emperor War began. She also knew how the world's situation would change after Gliek woke up from the white stone.
However, all the futures Margiella foresaw turned out to be wrong due to Ron's arrival at Genesis at the last minute.
"I have a bad feeling. Making Jin our man, it seems like it can never happen in the future."
"Did you confirm that future with your ability?"
When Zephyrin asked, Margiella shook her head.
"I can't see Jin's fate at all. It just feels like Jin has become further from us now that things have turned out this way."
"Already, that devil is very far from us."
"That's not wrong either"
"And even if the fate you saw had flowed as planned, would Jin have been further from us?"
"His heart would have drifted away, but he would have inevitably needed our help."
A Jeokho tribe rushed to find the executives.
"What's the matter?"
Berakt glared at the carelessly rushing Jeokho tribe and asked.
"Jin Runcandel has come to the land of the Beasts! Huff, huff. He came to have the meeting he mentioned last time..."
The Jeokho tribe was so out of breath as if he had run a lot. And the reason he came running was none other than this.
"If I don't come out to the Yukayuka Market by noon, I will consider the meeting as if it never happened and leave!"
The eyes of the executives simultaneously landed on the clock on the wall.

There were only 2 minutes left until noon. Even if Zephyrine immediately transformed into his original form, broke through the headquarters ceiling, and flew at full speed, it was impossible to arrive within that time frame.

"Ha! Is that arrogant guy belittling us again like this? It's unacceptable, Mr. Berakth. Let's send a letter to Tikan. If he doesn't come back to the land of the Therianthropes by today, we'll attack Tikan immediately!"
Despite Joe's brash outcry, Berakth surprisingly showed a positive reaction.
However, the very next moment, as soon as Margiella shook her head, Berakth made Joe feel foolish.
"Shut up, Joe."
"That's right, Uncle Joe. Jin would never make an empty promise. If not now, we may never get another chance to see the machine and its blueprints."
The spaceship blueprints and the machine were also very important to Kinzelo. After all, they had initially tried to seize them, even accepting significant damages in the Sota Desert.
Margiella made a quick decision.
"I will open the door. I'm sorry, commander!"
As she waved her hand in the air, a massive steel door formed in the middle of the conference room. Unfortunately, at that moment, the Kinzelo commander lying in the inner office vomited blood again.
"Whenever he gets involved with that demon, my master's recovery is delayed...."
"Let's all go together!"
All the executives passed through the steel door that Margiella had opened. As soon as they arrived at Yukayuka Market, they were able to meet Jin, who was holding a wall clock.
"11:59:57 AM. It's a pity, if you were four seconds late, I wouldn't have had to converse with you lot. Seems like the items we got from the Sota Desert are also very necessary to you?"
"Um, long time no see. Jin! How have you been?"
Margiella tried hard to smile.
"I don't think we're the type to ask each other how we're doing, Margiella."
"I think so too, Jin. We were in such a hurry that we couldn't bring the engineers, so I trust you'll understand. Otherwise, it would be quite dull."
When Zephyrine clenched his teeth and spoke, Jin chuckled.
"Well, alright. I understand that. However, you guys have committed a heinous crime. You knew that Gliek could awaken, didn't you?"

"Even if we knew, what's the problem? It's just that our intelligence was ahead. As you said, we're not close enough to ask about each other's well-being, and we're certainly not allies, so there was no need to share."

"You're right. Since we're not allies, I just want to charge you with a heinous crime. In fact, there's no need to share what we got from the Sota Desert with you guys. Therefore, there's one more condition for this meeting. If you want to see the goods...."
Tell me how Vermont found Temar's body.
Jin continued with a stern expression.
